name: guance-windows-electron-mixed-preview
description: Standalone Electron RUM preview with a C++ host owning the Windows SDK Handle

scripts.native:build: npm run native:install && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-native.ps1
scripts.start: npm run electron:install && npm run preload:build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start.ps1
scripts.verify: npm run preload:build && npm run verify:native && npm run verify:electron
scripts.check: node --check main.cjs && node --check preload-source.cjs && node --check renderer.js && npm test
